jobs.title: Sales Program Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
Sales Program Manager - Europe

Company:
Boeing Netherlands B.V.

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Sales Program Manager to join the Boeing team in Amsterdam or Madrid .

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options.

Position Responsibilities:
- Supports the approval process by advocating the customer requirements and selling the business case to management to ensure quality deal. Balances the enterprise, business unit and customer goals to meet and drive Long Range Business Plan (LRBP).
- Supports negotiations and finalizes commitments, ensuring mutual benefit to the customer and Boeing by interfacing directly with customer decision-makers and influencers. Leverages detailed understanding of both customer and Boeing needs and resources to find areas of alignment and integration. Obtains commitment within parameters approved by management.
- Drives sales and campaign activities to successful completion by integrating multiple aspects of the customers' needs. Crafts campaign specific strategies, procures resources and secures management commitment to ensure successful execution.
- Creates metrics to monitor campaign project status and budget requirements. Leverages company resources to support customer commitments, gain a competitive advantage and foster business growth by using a comprehensive understanding (breadth and depth) of multiple Boeing products and services, process and operations and resources.
- Integrates knowledge into business strategies and solutions. Researches, reviews and analyzes information about competitors' products and services to develop a comprehensive understanding (breadth and depth) of specific competitor activities and their impact on company strategy to improve our competitive position.
- Verifies, evaluates and applies detailed customer knowledge to advance campaign activity, support the long-range business plan (LRBP) and contribute to strategy development (e.g., country, region and campaign).
- Establishes a broad network of contacts and knowledge base to act as a broker of knowledge to multiple customer needs. Provides guidance to more junior employees regarding capturing and documenting detailed customer knowledge and assists in network development. Initiates and advances customer relationships and works to be accepted as a trusted business partner by the customer.
- Establishes, maintains and expands network to address customer needs and keep lines of communication open. Develops customer solutions by coordinating and integrating with internal and external processes and divisions to provide a competitive advantage and to foster business growth with acceptable margins.
- Coordinates packaging of Boeing and Industry products and knowledge into complete solutions that meets customer needs. Leads review process with management by balancing customer expectations and Boeing resources. Aligns third party deliverables.
- Maintains and advances customer relationships to proactively address future needs. Identifies future business opportunities and promotes the value of Boeing portfolio and partnership. Provides networking capabilities to address needs beyond Boeing's resources and offerings. Takes consultative approach to help customers achieve objectives. Leads preparation of proposals by developing themes and discriminators and ensures correct members and resources are included in the team. Recommends alternative means of compliance to customer requests. Reviews and contributes to the final draft materials. Challenges recommended scope and cost to ensure compliance and competitiveness.
- Develops strategy and tactics using in-depth knowledge of customer needs, Boeing products and services and competitive environment to foster business growth with acceptable margins. Ensures strategic alignment with the customer, Long Range Business Plan and regional and country objectives.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):
- 10+ years experience in a sales and marketing role
- 10+ years experience interacting with internal and external stakeholders
- 10+ years business analysis experience including detailed financial assessments
- High proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):
- Experience in Boeing Commercial Airplane or Boeing Global Services sales, marketing and/or contracts
- Experience engaging with commercial customers in the aviation industry
- Multi-lingual proficiency

Work Authorisation
This requisition is for a locally hired position in the Netherlands and Spain. Candidates must have current legal authorisation to work immediately in the Netherlands or Spain. Boeing will not attempt to obtain Immigration and labour sponsorship for any applicants.
Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S.-based payroll.

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Not Applicable

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent

Senior Program Management Manager

Company:

The Boeing Company has a long tradition of aerospace leadership and innovation, and Boeing Global Services (BGS) continues this tradition today by delivering unparalleled aftermarket support and services for customers worldwide.

We have an exciting leadership opportunity within Boeing Global Services (BGS) Parts and Distribution business leading our Consumables & Expendables Exclusives IPT (Integrated Product Team).

This Senior Program Management Manager role will be reporting to the Director of Distribution Programs.

Location: Hialeah, FL, Chandler, AZ, O Fallon, MO, or Wichita, KS.

Position Responsibilities:

We need a Senior Manager to join our team and bring the following:
- P&L Leader with ability to manage multiple, complex projects by establishing key metrics and standardized processes to measure performance and drive efficiencies
- Responsible for contract oversight and execution of a diverse mix of product lines spanning many platforms across Commercial, BAGA and Defense aftermarket segments
- Development of Portfolio Strategy and Product Line expansion with key OEM/Supplier Partners
- Set short- and long-term product strategies and evaluate effectiveness of sales and marketing initiatives
- Lead SIOP strategies to maximize investments, mitigate risks and improve business outcomes
- Support LRBP (Long Range Business Plan) process and deliver to Portfolio financial targets across Revenue, Margin, Operating Earnings and Cash

- Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration or related field
- 10+ years of work experience
- 5+ years of experience in Product or Program Management within aerospace parts and distribution
- Previous experience in managing/leading larger teams
- 5+ years of experience in aviation, aerospace and/or defense industry

jobs.title: Little Mountain Test Facility Senior Program Manager & Site Manager
jobs.description:
Little Mountain Test Facility Senior Program Manager & Site Manager

Company:
The Boeing Company

Boeing is seeking a highly experienced Senior Program Manager & Site Manager to lead the Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Little Mountain Test Facility (LMTF) Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Program , located in Ogden, Utah, at a Hill Air Force Base (HAFB) annex.

The Boeing Senior Program Manager & Site Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall execution, performance, and administration of Boeing’s  Strategic Deterrence Systems (SDS)  program at LMTF. This position provides on-site leadership for day-to-day execution and holds primary responsibility, accountability, and authority for LMTF’s O&M program, including associated delivery order CLINs for add-on test contracts, equipment purchase contracts, new test capability contracts, facility support contracts, and all commercial test execution contracts performed under the LMTF Cooperative Research & Development Agreement (CRADA).

This role also provides leadership oversight for LMTF modernization and future growth initiatives, including research, development, design, and integration of new technology insertions supporting nuclear hardness test capabilities and facility development. In addition, the Program Manager & Site Manager is responsible for overseeing site operations, serving as the primary Boeing interface and point of contact to Government stakeholders, maintaining a safe and compliant work environment, and ensuring LMTF laboratories and facilities remain fully operational and effective in support of mission requirements.

The Program Manager & Site Manager is the key operational leader for LMTF’s complex and unique test laboratories, sustainment activities, and safety-sensitive environments involving functional interfaces across multiple laboratories and facilities, maintenance coordination, and mission-critical test schedule execution. This position directs operational, technical, staffing, safety, security, cyber, quality, and sustainment activities necessary to support mission-critical testing, maintenance, facility operations, and modernization efforts in accordance with contractual requirements and Government direction. Other responsibilities include developing and maintaining an overall program organizational structure aligned with contractual cost and execution requirements, mission priorities, and overall program objectives. This includes ensuring appropriate personnel are assigned to each position with the applicable skills, experience, and staffing levels to effectively support program execution while remaining within overall program cost constraints.

The Boeing Program Manager & Site Manager is responsible for ensuring contract compliance, mission readiness, and successful delivery of all program objectives through leadership of a team of 100+ employees and support staff, including lab and engineering managers, site operations managers, engineers, scientists, technicians, program and project specialists, business operations staff, and support personnel. This position includes direct oversight of project specialists, business operations staff, and first-line managers supporting LMTF’s program management, business operations, and site support functions.
LMTF supports the AFNWC mission by providing test environments to study, analyze, and evaluate the effects of nuclear and operational conditions on ICBM weapon systems in support of warfighter nuclear capabilities. The mission directly supports the AFNWC ICBM portfolio, including Minuteman III and Sentinel. LMTF’s primary focus is to support Minuteman III and Sentinel weapon system testing, as well as other AFNWC portfolio programs, Department of Defense (DoD) and Department of Energy (DOE) programs, and approved mission partners requiring testing to assess system survivability, vulnerability, and performance. LMTF’s vision is to ensure its test capabilities and facilities meet sustainment, modernization, and mission requirements, safeguarding the land-based leg of the nuclear triad and providing test support to other mission partners as available.

Primary (Core) Responsibilities

Boeing’s Program Manager & Site Manager is responsible for leading and directing all phases of the LMTF program. The primary core responsibilities include:
- Program Execution: - Lead program planning, execution, financial management, and stakeholder reporting for the LMTF portfolio, including sustainment, testing, and modernization efforts.
- Ensure program objectives are achieved in alignment with contractual commitments, technical requirements, and customer expectations.

- Cost Management & Resource Allocation:   - Serve as the primary Cost Account Manager (CAM) with direct oversight of budgets, resources, and schedules.
- Ensure appropriate staffing levels and resource allocations are established across all functional areas.
- Coordinate new or redirected resources across all site functions as required.
- Oversee technical management of suppliers and drive process improvements.
- Coordinate emergency response, after-hours response, and urgent operational needs as required.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to obtain support for specialized nuclear hardness requirements.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to address specialized requests and on-site support to meet mission requirements (e.g. Supplier Management, Corporate “P-Card Compliance”, Quality, Safety, Logistics, etc.).

- Program Status & Performance: - Track and report program status and performance, including cost, schedule, technical performance, operational status, and mission impacts, to program leadership and Government representatives.
- Participate in and/or lead internal and external program management reviews, technical interchange meetings, readiness reviews, customer briefings, and site tours and visits from Distinguished Visitors (DVs).
- Establish and maintain weekly and monthly reviews and status calls with key Government stakeholders.
- Lead daily Tier meetings, weekly staff meetings, and monthly all employee meetings.
- Develop, implement, and maintain a site Risk, Issue, and Opportunity (RIO) management plan.

- Program Compliance: - Maintain compliance with customer, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
- Maintain adherence to applicable security, radiation safety, cybersecurity, environmental, health, safety, and other functional requirements as applicable.
- Oversee and verify that all contractual deliverables are completed accurately and delivered on schedule.

- Overall Program Leadership: - Serve as the primary site-level point of contact for all Government stakeholders.
- Coordinate daily program execution across all functional support activities, including nuclear hardness and survivability laboratories, test stands, facilities, maintenance, logistics, and support teams.

- Modernization & Program Growth:   - Support and drive new business opportunities and growth across LMTF’s modernization of facilities, laboratories, and nuclear hardness test capabilities.
- Lead future program opportunities and proposal efforts supporting long-term sustainment and growth.

- Personnel Management & Mentorship: - Manage direct reports, including schedules, performance reviews, and ongoing workforce coordination.
- Provide mentorship, guidance, and professional development for site programs, project, and business operations staff.
- Foster collaboration between the program office and site teams.

- Safety & Quality:   - Champion and promote a strong site-wide culture of safety, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.
- Communicate the importance of safety and ensure all personnel understand safety as a top priority.
- Drive continuous improvement and quality-focused practices across all LMTF functions.
- This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the list location options.

This position must meet Export Control compliance requirements, therefore a “US Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 is required. “US Person” includes US Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

This position requires the ability to obtain U.S. Security Clearance, for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim and/or final U.S. top secret clearance Post Start is required.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)

LMTF Contract Requirement:
- 15+ years of management / leadership experience in engineering, program management, or site leadership role.
- 5+ years minimum ICBM experience
- Bachelor’s degree from an ABED accredited university in engineering, engineering technology, business, management, technical discipline, or related field
- Experience working with Senior leadership levels at or in the Air Force or DOD (Department of Defense) acquisition community
- Excellent leadership and communication skills to effectively coordinate with diverse teams.
- Previous experience utilizing Program Management Best Practices (PMBP)

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills and Experience)

- Nuclear hardness and survivability experience supporting Little Mountain Test Facility or similar test facilities.
- Experience leading projects that require integration across business units and/or multiple functions
- Experience in program management for both small programs and large programs
- Strong communication, problem solving and analytical skills with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure
- Experience creating and implementing projects, programs or communication plans, strategies, and tactics
- Experience in preparing and presenting executive level briefings
- Master’s Degree and 20+ year’s experience in a Leadership or Management position.
- Experience coordinating multiple functional disciplines, including operations, maintenance, safety, security, logistics, and facilities.
- Demonstrated experience managing operational teams in a mission-critical environment (e.g. laboratories with nuclear hardness and survivability requirements).
- Background and knowledge of electromagnetic effects, shock and vibration, and radiation simulation technology, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.
- Familiarity with quality assurance processes and continuous improvement methodologies.
- Experience in developing and managing technical, cost, and schedule metrics and technical performance measures (TPM)

jobs.description:
Business Operations Specialist

Company:
The Boeing Company

Boeing Commercial Airplanes is seeking a Business Operations Specialist (Level 4) to join our team in North Charleston, South Carolina on 1st shift.

Seeking a highly experienced, strategic, and results-driven Business Operations Director Analyst to join our cross-functional leadership team. In this pivotal role, you will lead the development and integration of programs, plans, and processes that enable disciplined work, drive cost and deployment strategy, mitigate risk, and ensure delivery against long-range business objectives. You will partner with 787 executive leadership, management, suppliers, and internal organizations to translate complex situations, including analytics, into approved business cases, presentations, effective communication, and executable plans.

Position Responsibilities :
- Lead development and integration of information management across organizations, change management, strategies, cost imperatives and deployment plans to meet multi-year business goals.

- Deliver executive-ready presentations and decision materials; present recommendations to senior leadership and governance boards to obtain commitment and funding.

- Prepare, validate and refine business cases and investment proposals by combining quantitative analysis, scenario modeling, and qualitative risk assessment.

- Coordinate cross-functional review and alignment with Fulfillment, supply chain, manufacturing, program management, quality, engineering, and more to define scope and secure approvals.

- Identify, quantify and prioritize risks and opportunities; develop and track mitigation plans and contingency actions.

- Provide implementation direction for work, tracking commitments and ensuring downstream teams understand deliverables, timelines and acceptance criteria.

- Establish and maintain management system data flows: collect, validate and report status of programs, customer/supplier commitments and compliance metrics.

- Drive issue resolution to closure — escalate when appropriate and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into process improvements.

- Mentor and coach less-experienced analysts; lead or contribute to initiatives that raise team capability and analytical rigor.

- Champion continuous improvement and standardization of tools, templates and processes across the organization.

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Operations Research, or a closely related discipline is required.

- 10+ years' of progressive experience in business operations, program control, financial planning & analysis, sourcing strategy, or relevant related roles.

- 5+ years' experience operating at a senior/senior-analyst or director-level capacity driving cross-functional decision-making and approvals.

- 5+ years; demonstrated experience building and defending multi-year business cases, approval packages and governance-ready decision materials.

- 5+ years experience collaborating with senior leaders and complex stakeholder networks (finance, PMO, sourcing, engineering, analytics, commercial) to drive alignment and execution.

- 5+ years' hands-on experience in risk identification, scenario modeling, mitigation planning, and quantifying cost-to-complete and benefits realization.

- 5+ years' experience in strong data analysis and modeling skills; to include Excel

- 5+ years' business intelligence / visualization experience (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and familiarity with centralized program management systems.

- Prior leadership/mentorship experience with a record of developing less-experienced staff.

- Excellent written and verbal communication — ability to synthesize complex analyses into concise executive presentations.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):
- Master’s degree (MBA, MS) preferred

- PMP, PgMP, or similar program management certification.

- Six Sigma/Lean certification (Green Belt or Black Belt).

- Experience with SQL, Python, or other data tools for analysis is highly valued.

- Financial Certification: CFA level or other advanced finance credentials a plus.

Company:
Boeing Commercial Aviation Services Europe Limited

With more than a century of experience, Boeing’s knowledge in bringing innovative service solutions to commercial, defence and space customers has united to form Boeing Global Services.

With a focus on innovative services in engineering, digital aviation and analytics as well as supply chain logistics and training support, Boeing will deliver agile, cost-competitive solutions, regardless of the original equipment manufacturer, so customers can reduce costs, drive efficiency and optimize operations.

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

The Role:
The successful candidate will work within the Boeing Global Services Programme Management team, based in the UK.

The Programme Management team manage the post-delivery modification of aircraft for our Customers. The projects we typically manage involve the integration of new equipment into the aircraft, such as seating, IFE equipment and monuments (galleys, lavatories and stowages). We frequently manage multiple stakeholders providing equipment and services to the Customer. Working together with the Engineering, Airworthiness and supply chain teams you will assist with managing the execution of the project within the schedule and budgetary constraints agreed.

This is a junior role within the programme management team offering an opportunity to develop your skills within a world class organisation.

Previous experience within the aerospace industry or relevant degree would be a distinct advantage as will a working knowledge of Programme Management processes.

Responsibilities:
- Act as focal point for the company to worldwide airline customers

- Assist Senior Programme Managers with delivery schedules, meeting quality standards, and financial controls from project award to final delivery

- Identify and manage programme risks, issues and opportunities to protect or improve the programme performance

- Assist Senior Programme Managers to lead internal programme teams executing the programme requirements

- Coordinate internal activities to ensure all tasks are progressing in line with the programme requirements

- Help coordinate and assist with major milestone meetings with the customer (ITCM, PDR, CDR, FAI) and compile resulting minutes and action plans

- Portray the customers’ expectations and requirements to the Engineering team to ensure alignment

- Provide weekly status updates, milestone schedules and risk analysis summaries

- Communicate programme status, on-going financial viability and identification of key issues to senior management

- Manage customer change requests and support proposals for schedule and cost related impact

- Initiate invoicing of project payments and follow-up on payment as required

Company:

Boeing is seeking a highly experienced and motivated Senior Enterprise Program Manager located in Aurora, CO , to lead and execute a mission critical Operations & Maintenance (O&M) portfolio.

This key personnel role will manage complex facilities and logistics services that ensure mission readiness and sustainment across 24x7 operational environments. The incumbent will apply advanced program and risk management practices, lead integrated teams, and coordinate support for exercises, crisis response, and special events. The role requires demonstrated leadership in program management in a dynamic government environment spanning multiple geographic locations. Deep knowledge of exercise and crisis management policies to drive readiness and resilient operations is necessary.

Position Responsibilities:
- Serve as the program lead and principal point of contact for government stakeholders and internal leadership for assigned O&M programs, ensuring contractual, technical, schedule, and cost requirements are met
- Develop, implement, and continuously improve program-level processes, procedures, and metrics to manage cost, schedule, scope, quality, risk, and deliverables
- Establish and sustain high-performing, integrated, cross-functional teams (including prime/subcontractor coordination) to execute operational tasks and deliverables
- Oversee 24x7 operational support activities, ensuring continuity of operations, effective shift coverage, and robust handoff procedures
- Plan, coordinate, and deliver program support for exercises, crisis management, special events, and agile contingency operations
- Lead development and delivery of program plans, status reports, performance metrics, forecasts, budgets, earned value/cost analysis, and briefings to internal and external stakeholders
- Implement process improvement initiatives using recognized models (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, CMMI) to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve service quality
- Identify, analyze, and mitigate program risks; maintain integrated risk registers and ensure escalations as required
- Ensure compliance with security, special program access, and applicable Intelligence Community and DoD policies and directives
- Drive continuous customer engagement to anticipate needs, resolve issues, and maintain high-quality customer service
- Maintain readiness to support emergency tasking, shifts in mission priorities, and rapid workforce re-allocation during crises

Company:

Boeing Global Services (BGS) is looking for a Senior Quality Systems Specialist (Program Management Quality) to join their Vertical Lift Quality Team in Mesa, AZ. This position will become a Quality point of contact for all BGS Apache contractual work.

Position Responsibilities:
·         Involved in the contract proposal and award process to ensure all Quality attributes are incorporated
·         Performs Early Quality Involvement (EQI) and Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP)
·         Incorporates quality attributes into contracts proactively to mitigate risk during contract execution phases
·         Validates supplier readiness and capability partnered with Supplier Quality during contract proposals
·         Integrates with Program Management to ensure proper quality requirement are applied to contracts
·         Identifies and corrects risk to the Quality Management System (QMS) & Safety Management System (SMS)
·         Works Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) to correct product and process non-conformances impacting the program
·         Operates as the BGS Mesa Notice of Escape (NOE) focal
·         Operates as the BGS Mesa Product Quality Deficiency Report (PQDR) focal
·         Partners with BGS Mesa Internal Auditor to identify and correct non-compliances
·         Partners with the BGS Mesa Corrective and Preventative Action (CAPA) Focal
